As an  operator, you will be responsible for the entire carrot processing process within your line.

You will ensure that the installation runs optimally and continuously monitor the quality and efficiency.

Your tasks will include:

• Checking incoming carrots and correctly storing them in the bunkers

• Operating, monitoring, and adjusting the machines responsible for the entire peeling process

• Continuously monitoring the production process and intervening where necessary

• Taking responsibility for the process until the grated carrots arrive in the production hall, where the further process is taken over by the team

The company cuts and packages fresh vegetables in an innovative way and produces creative ready-to-eat meal salads for the retail and food service sector. 

• A strong sense of responsibility and attention to detail

• Technically minded and able to monitor and adjust machines

• Fluent in English

• Experience as an operator or in a production environment is a plus

Are you a night owl with a talent for solving technical challenges?

Do you thrive in a modern production environment where teamwork and quality are top priorities? Then this is the opportunity for you!

Your role

As a Maintenance Technician in the fixed night shift, you are essential to our production process. You ensure that machines operate at their best, perform preventive maintenance, and resolve malfunctions quickly and effectively. With your technical skills and problem-solving mindset, you keep the production running even while the world sleeps.

What will you do?

• Carry out preventive and corrective maintenance on machines and installations.

• Detect, analyze, and fix malfunctions (primarily electrical, ideally with mechanical expertise).

• Start up and optimize production lines.

• Actively contribute to improving the reliability and efficiency of the equipment.

• Collaborate with a team and report to the technical service manager.

Work schedule

• 2 workdays (2 x 7.36 hours) and 2 weekend days (2 x 11 hours), offering a steady yet varied schedule.

 

 

• A technical degree or relevant experience in a production environment.

• Broad technical knowledge of mechanics, electricity, and pneumatics; PLC knowledge is a plus.

• A flexible, positive attitude and strong problem-solving skills.

• A team player who is eager to learn and improve.

• Fluency in Dutch or English.

Safran est un groupe international de haute technologie opérant dans les domaines de l'aéronautique (propulsion, équipements et intérieurs), de l'espace et de la défense. Sa mission : contribuer durablement à un monde plus sûr, où le transport aérien devient toujours plus respectueux de l'environnement, plus confortable et plus accessible. Implanté sur tous les continents, le Groupe emploie 110 000 collaborateurs pour un chiffre d'affaires de 31,3 milliards d'euros en 2025, et occupe, seul ou en partenariat, des positions de premier plan mondial ou européen sur ses marchés. Safran est la 2ème entreprise du secteur aéronautique et défense du classement « World's Best Companies 2025 » du magazine TIME.Safran Aircraft Engines conçoit, produit et commercialise, seul ou en coopération, des moteurs aéronautiques civils et militaires aux meilleurs niveaux de performance, fiabilité et respect de l'environnement. La société est notamment, à travers CFM International*, le leader mondial de la propulsion d'avions commerciaux courts et moyen-courriers.* CFM International est une société commune 50/50 de Safran Aircraft Engines et GE Aerospace.Parce que nous sommes persuadés que chaque talent compte, nous valorisons et encourageons les candidatures de personnes en situation de handicap pour nos opportunités d'emploi.

We're hiring an Operations Shift Manager to reinforce and support our Operations teams. Your role:

• You are a natural leader, guiding and inspiring a multidisciplinary team to successfully deliver the production plan.
• You make things happen, turning weekly planning into a clear daily schedule and deploying the right people and resources to get the job done.
• As a coach and motivator, you ensure flawless execution, support your team's growth, and directly impact the success of our operations.
• In this role you report to the Operations Manager and Operations Director.

Your profile:

• You are both a leader and a team player, able to inspire while collaborating with others.
• You bring expertise, holding a Bachelor or Master in Electromechanics with 3-5 years of relevant experience in an industrial environment.
• You have strong people management skills and the drive to take on new challenges with confidence.
• You are analytical and resilient, thriving under pressure and keeping a sharp focus on deadlines.
• You are communicative and fluent in Dutch, French and English.
• You are flexible, ready to work in shifts (Monday to Friday: 6am-2pm, 2pm-10pm).
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.As part of our growth (RAMP UP) of LEAP engines, we are looking for a CNC Operator to strengthen our teams.

As experienced CNC machine operator, you will oversee our computer numeric controlled (CNC) machines. You will be responsible for ensuring machining of subassembly, quality parts and tools specific to engineering drawings dimensions.

Your Role:

• Set up and operate CNC machines to perform various tasks, including drilling, grinding, and milling.
• Ensure CNC machines operate in compliance with company guidelines and safety standards.
• Monitor machines during operation and make necessary adjustments to optimize results.
• Inspect machinery daily to ensure proper functionality.
• Record all machine activities by completing production and quality logs.
• Provide accurate timelines and updates to clients.
• Communicate with the Methods Department regarding any issues encountered during machining.
• Ensure that machining results meet the defined work scope and quality expectations.
• Conduct regular assessments and maintenance of CNC machines.

Your Profile:

• High school diploma or equivalent qualification required.
• Minimum of 3 years of experience as a CNC machine operator.
• Ability to read and interpret mechanical documents and engineering drawings.
• Strong mechanical aptitude.
• Excellent attention to detail and a goal-oriented attitude.
• Strong comprehension and analytical skills.
• Knowledge of the latest equipment and techniques in the industry.
• Good computer skills.
• You have a very knowledge of technical English and a basic understanding of Dutch or French, with the desire to improve it.
• Willingness to work in a 3-shift system
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

To strengthen our Supply Chain Team we are looking for a Configuration & Logistics Officer who ensures that for a given engine, the pieces are made available for assembly within the configuration and timeframe agreed with the customer.Your role:

• You will analyse and provide the logistical needs to complete the engine.
• You read and understand the logistical aspects of the Bill of Work for the engine.
• You detect critical points in the completion process and look for an appropriate solution to achieve the objectives (e.g. Standard Exchanges, switches between different engines).
• You direct your internal suppliers (warehouse, backshop, subcontracting, purchasing).
• You complete the modules and ensure that they are prepared according to the predetermined production planning.
• You support the assembly line with missing and/or defective parts.
• You analyse the interchangeability (technical and qualitative) of pieces, in accordance with the established configuration.

Your profile:

• You have a Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain or a technical direction, or equivalent through experience.
• You have an interest in aircraft engines and want to learn more about them.
• You are communicative and dare to ask questions.
• You work in a structured, accurate and proactive way.
• You work analytically and come up with practical solutions.
• You organize, divide and control your work independently.
• You speak French or Dutch, you also have a good knowledge of technical English.
• Experience with SAP is a plus.
• You work in shifts, from Monday to Friday (6 am - 2 pm, 2 pm - 10 pm).
Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

• You will review the work documents that contain the necessary elements to perform the tasks (materials, products, technical instructions, references to the reference documents, and procedures);

• Managing engine induction into the workshop and reporting defects or damage
• Dismantling and assembling engine modules
• Ensuring compliance with quality, safety, and environmental requirements
• Participating in continuous improvement projects
• Completing technical documentation for traceability
• Reporting anomalies in work instructions and proposing improvements

You bring:

• Technical high school diploma in mechanics, aeronautics or a related field
• Strong mechanical aptitude and interest in aircraft engines
• A high level of precision, ownership and attention to detail
• A strong quality and safety mindset

• Excellent technical English; Dutch and/or French

To strengthen our Accounts Team we are looking for a Customer Operations Manager (Jet Engines):The Customer Operations Manager leads the Shop Visit Managers and administrators within the Accounts team. This team consolidates the factory-wide operational status and plays a key role in ensuring transparent communication, coordination, and escalation management to support the efficient execution of engine shop visits.The Customer Operations Manager and his/her team are also responsible for the relationship, communication, and shop visit coordination with our external customers (airlines). He/she acts as the main point of contact for new customer onboarding, the management of complaints and disputes, and any other customer-related matters. He/she represents the customer and their contractual constraints internally within the shop.Your role:

• Lead and coordinate a team of Shop Visit Managers (engine owners), fostering performance, collaboration, and professional development.
• Oversee the work-in-progress status of all engine projects, ensuring adherence to commitments, schedules, and customer requirements.
• Act as the key interface between Operations, Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, and the customer, ensuring clear communication and accurate reporting on project status and progress.
• Manage customer contractual constraints within the SAESB engine shop.
• Host customer visits, providing visibility on shop performance and ensuring a positive customer experience.
• Lead strategic projects aimed at improving engine induction and delivery processes.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing operational performance and customer feedback, with the goal of enhancing volume output and efficiency.

Your profile:

• You hold a master's degree in engineering with a strong business affinity, or a degree in Business/Economics with a strong technical affinity or equivalent by experience.
• You have strong business acumen and a results-driven mindset.
• Experience in the aerospace or aeronautical industry is considered a strong asset.
• You have at least 3 years of proven people management experience.
• You are an excellent communicator and are fluent in English. Good knowledge of Dutch and French is a strong asset.
• You possess strong interpersonal, stakeholder management, and representational skills.
• You have a strong customer-oriented mindset.

We are looking for an Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM) to strengthen our teams.Your role:As an Information Systems Security Manager, you protect the organization's information and digital assets against cyber threats by implementing the Safran Information Systems Security Policy.

• You will report to the Information Systems & Digital Transformation Director.
• You will implement the Safran Information Systems Security Policy within the subsidiary.
• As a member of the SAE and Safran ISSM community, you participate in its activities and act as the local representative at SAESB.
• You manage risks and compliance:
• You verify hardware and software compliance and monitor the execution of remediation plans.
• You drive regulatory compliance (GDPR, NIS2, Part-IS, etc.) and conduct cyber risk assessments.
• You coordinate responses to security incidents in collaboration with SAE and Safran.
• You test the Business Continuity Plan (BCP) and Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP).
• You lead cybersecurity awareness and training programs to strengthen the company's cybersecurity culture.

Your profile:

• 3 to 5 years of experience as an Information Systems Security Manager (ISSM/CISO) within a company of more than 100 employees.
• Experience in an industrial environment is an asset.
• Good technical knowledge of IT and cloud architectures and infrastructures.
• Knowledge of operational security and detection components (SOC, SIEM, EDR protection tools, etc.).
• Knowledge of security standards and frameworks (ISO 27001), regulatory requirements (GDPR, NIS2, EASA Part-IS), and risk analysis methodologies.
• Strong team spirit and ability to work collaboratively.
• Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills.
• Ability to manage stress and urgent situations.
• Organized, rigorous, autonomous, and accountable.
• Fluency in French and English, good Dutch.

• You respond to customer enquiries by telephone and email, identify customers' needs and provide clear, helpful and professional support.
 
• You ensure a smooth and accurate order flow, from receiving orders to invoicing.
 
• You create, update and maintain customer accounts and ensure that customer information is complete and accurate.
 
• You support customers with webshop enquiries, online ordering, account access and other website-related issues.
 
• You assist with the day-to-day aministration of online webshops, including order follow-up, customer questions and issue resolution.

• You maintain up-to-date knowledge of products, prices, promotions, procedures and online information to resolve customer questions effectively.

• You are a native English speaker with excellent spoken and written communication skills.
 
• You are customer-focused, empathetic, flexible and a strong communicator.

• You are comfortable using webshops, online platforms, Microsoft Office and customer or order-management systems.
 
• You can set priorities, organize your work and follow customer requests through to completion.
 
• You are enthusiastic, eager to learn and enjoy working as part of a team.
 
• You are comfortable with routine administrative tastks and maintain a positive approach in every customer interaction.
 
• You have a commercial mindset and know how to combine customer focus with result-oriented working.
 
• You are available for a full-time position.
